info.title: Taskdeck API
info.description: Local-first execution workspace API. Provides board management, capture pipeline, chat-to-proposal automation, webhook integrations, and review-first governance.

get.summary: Get the current abuse status for a specific actor (user).
Get the abuse event audit trail for a specific actor.

post.summary:
Operator override: set an actor to any abuse state.
Used for both escalation and de-escalation (including clearing/unblocking).

Trigger abuse evaluation for a specific actor.
Evaluates recent LLM usage against abuse thresholds.

get.summary: Gets a list of archived items with optional filters.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Filter by entity type (board, column, card)

get.summary: Gets a specific archive item by ID.

post.summary: Restores an archived item.
Authenticate with username/email and password. Returns a JWT token.
Register a new user account. Returns a JWT token.
Change the password for an existing user.

get.summary: Initiates GitHub OAuth login flow. Only available when GitHub OAuth is configured.
Handles the GitHub OAuth callback, creates/links the user, and redirects with a JWT token.

post.summary:
Exchanges a short-lived OAuth authorization code for a JWT token.
The code is single-use and expires after 60 seconds.

get.summary: Returns whether GitHub OAuth login is available on this instance.
Gets a list of automation proposals with optional filters.

post.summary: Creates a new automation proposal with operations.

get.summary: Gets a specific automation proposal by ID with all operations.

post.summary: Approves a pending automation proposal.
Rejects a pending automation proposal.
Executes an approved automation proposal through the automation executor.

Dismisses completed proposals so they no longer appear in the default review list.
Accepts an array of proposal IDs; only proposals in terminal states (Applied, Rejected, Failed, Expired) will be dismissed.

get.summary: Gets a diff preview for a proposal showing what changes will be made.
List boards accessible to the current user.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional text filter applied to board names.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: When true, archived boards are included in the results.

post.summary: Create a new board.

400.description: Validation error in the request body.

get.summary: Get a board by ID, including its columns.

404.description: Board not found or not accessible.
Board not found or not accessible.
Board not found or not accessible.

post.summary: Create a new capture item. This is the primary quick-capture endpoint.

requestBody.description: Capture item content including text and optional board target.

get.summary: List capture items for the current user with optional filters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by capture status (e.g., Pending, Triaging, Processed, Ignored, Cancelled).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50).

get.summary: Get a single capture item by ID.

post.summary: Mark a capture item as ignored (dismissed without triage).
Cancel a capture item (e.g., if it was submitted in error).

Enqueue a capture item for triage. The system will generate an automation
proposal that the user must review before any board changes are applied.

202.description: Triage enqueued — proposal will be generated asynchronously.

get.summary: Search cards on a board with optional filters.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional text search across card titles and descriptions.

403.description: User does not have read access to this board.

post.summary: Create a new card on a board.

requestBody.description: Card creation parameters including title, column, and optional labels.

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

get.summary:
Get capture provenance for a card, showing the link back to the
capture item and proposal that created it.

403.description: User does not have read access to this board.

patch.summary: Update card fields. Supports optimistic concurrency via ExpectedUpdatedAt.

requestBody.description: Fields to update (all optional). Include ExpectedUpdatedAt for conflict detection.

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

409.description: Conflict — the card was modified since ExpectedUpdatedAt.

delete.summary: Delete a card from a board.

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

post.summary: Move a card to a different column and/or position.

400.description: Validation error (e.g., WIP limit exceeded on target column).

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

post.summary: Create a new chat session, optionally scoped to a board.

requestBody.description: Session parameters including title and optional board scope.

get.summary: List all chat sessions for the current user.
Check the health and availability of the configured LLM provider.

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: When true, sends a lightweight test request to the provider.

get.summary: Get a chat session by ID, including recent messages.

post.summary:
Send a message in a chat session. The LLM responds and may generate
automation proposals when RequestProposal is true.

requestBody.description: Message content and optional proposal request flag.

get.summary:
Stream the LLM response for a chat session via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Events are emitted as "message.delta" (partial tokens) and "message.complete" (final).
List all columns for a board, ordered by position.

200.description: Returns the columns for the board.

403.description: User does not have read access to this board.

post.summary: Create a new column on a board.

requestBody.description: Column creation parameters including name and optional WIP limit.

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

patch.summary: Update a column's name, position, or WIP limit.

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

delete.summary: Delete a column from a board. The column must be empty (no cards).

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

post.summary: Reorder columns by providing the full list of column IDs in the desired order.

requestBody.description: The ordered list of column IDs.

400.description: Validation error (e.g., missing or extra column IDs).

403.description: User does not have write access to this board.

get.summary: List all webhook subscriptions for a board.

403.description: User does not have permission to manage webhooks on this board.

post.summary:
Create a new webhook subscription for a board. Returns the subscription
along with its signing secret (shown only once).

requestBody.description: Subscription parameters: endpoint URL and optional event type filters.

201.description: Subscription created. The signing secret is included in the response and will not be shown again.

403.description: User does not have permission to manage webhooks on this board.

post.summary:
Rotate the signing secret for a webhook subscription. The new secret is
returned in the response and will not be shown again.

403.description: User does not have permission to manage webhooks on this board.

delete.summary: Revoke (deactivate) a webhook subscription. Pending deliveries will be cancelled.

403.description: User does not have permission to manage webhooks on this board.
